about_the_game:
Episode 2: The Loop

A Group of students from Falica High School, was getting ready for the Halloween break until… Oh, wait I experience this before, what is going on?

After confront her mother, Janet goes into a time loop, seemingly endlessly without any help this time. Can she break the loop or stuck with it for the rest of her life? Meanwhile, in another part of the country, Raine watching over Azure as she recovered from her fainting spells, figuring out the mystery surrounding Azure and how she joins the Helper Security Association.

This DLC download and unlock Episode 2: The loop, And can be access through the episode select screen.
